summary: Prosecutors dismissed a Class B felony burglary charge against a Fairbanks man on Oct. 23, two days after a grand jury returned a lesser vehicle theft count in its place. Grand juries indicted four other Fairbanks-area defendants on Oct. 22 and Oct. 23, all on Class C felonies. The Alaska Court System's weekly charges report, covering Oct. 17 to Oct. 23, lists 42 new criminal cases at the Fairbanks courthouse and none at Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction; three cases filed Oct. 16 fall outside that window and are not in its counts.

entries.title: Burglary charge dismissed: Ryan Bud James
body: Prosecutors dismissed a first-degree burglary charge against Ryan Bud James on Oct. 23. The charge, a Class B felony flagged as domestic violence, came from an Oct. 10 incident in Fairbanks; a grand jury had returned a Class C felony vehicle theft count against the same charge two days earlier.
Four counts remain, among them first-degree vehicle theft, third-degree criminal mischief and third-degree assault. Case 4FA-26-02067CR; arraignment in Superior Court Oct. 28, trial week Nov. 23.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Darin Ryan Cleveland
body: Darin Ryan Cleveland, 40, was arrested on charges of driving under the influence and refusing to submit to a chemical test, recorded by police as misdemeanors. 1700 block of West Cowles Street, Fairbanks, Oct. 23 at 4:33 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.

entries.title: Indicted: Jeremy Frank Edwards
body: A grand jury indicted Jeremy Frank Edwards on Oct. 22. The file charges failing to stop at the direction of a peace officer while driving recklessly, a Class C felony, and driving under the influence, from an Oct. 14 incident in Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02088CR; arraignment in Superior Court Oct. 28.

entries.title: Indicted: Maya Denise Hernandez-Mullen
body: A grand jury indicted Maya Denise Hernandez-Mullen on Oct. 22 on one count of second-degree theft, value $750 to $24,999, a Class C felony, from an Oct. 15 incident in Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02096CR; arraignment in Superior Court Oct. 28.

entries.title: Indicted: John Edward Raymond Jr.
body: A grand jury indicted John Edward Raymond Jr. on Oct. 22 on two Class C felony counts, the first third-degree assault with two or more prior convictions, from an Oct. 16 incident in Fairbanks.
Case 4FA-26-02097CR; arraignment in Superior Court Oct. 28.

entries.title: Indicted: Dominique Dashea Frey
body: An indictment against Dominique Dashea Frey was filed in Superior Court on Oct. 23, on one count of third-degree criminal mischief, damage of $750 or more, a Class C felony flagged as domestic violence. The offense is recorded at North Pole on Oct. 14.

entries.title: Case closed on a change of plea: Cody Steven Rudolph-Munro
body: The court record for Cody Steven Rudolph-Munro shows a change of plea on Oct. 14 and a judgment order entered the same day. The file charged five counts from an Aug. 23 incident at North Pole, all flagged as domestic violence, including third-degree assault with a weapon and third-degree criminal mischief, both Class C felonies.
A December omnibus hearing and a January trial week are both recorded as vacated. Case 4FA-26-01644CR.

entries.title: Warrants issued in two misdemeanor cases
body: The Fairbanks court issued warrants on Oct. 23 in two misdemeanor cases, against Ishi Santana Sarten, charged with second-degree criminal trespass from an Oct. 17 incident in Fairbanks, and Landon Zachary Bedingfield, charged with driving under the influence and refusing a chemical test from an Oct. 17 incident at North Pole.
Cases 4FA-26-02106CR and 4FA-26-02107CR. Both men are charged, not convicted.
